intro: Hansel Heavyhands says that every time he wants a moment to relax and reflect on his life, the powers that be hand him another job. Greater lava spiders are causing a ruckus in the Searing Gorge, and he wants you to kill twenty of them.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Wouldn't ye know it, every time ol' Hansel wants to take a moment to relax and reflect upon his life, the powers that be give him another job.
Me gots to think, come on! Ye know what I be saying? Come. On.
So, these here greater lava spiders are causin' a ruckus o' some sort. Oilfist says they shoot fire out their... Erm, yea well, anyway, such things upset the children.
I guess we gots to kill 'em. Rather, ye gots to kill 'em.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Was he right? Does it come out their rumps?

clips.title: Completion
paras: I think I'm gettin' a cold. Damn this frigid climate!
